scope: Three requested topology reports and reuse of Auroux. This is not complete Section 6 coverage or a reconstruction of every research proof.

reports.speaker: Daniel A. Cristofaro-Gardiner
reports.title: Symplectic Weyl Laws
reports.question: 周期轨道的作用量怎样恢复体积，并限制局部动力学与面积保持群？
reports.reading_scope: arXiv v1 main text sections 1-5 and selected bibliography; publisher chapter metadata checked, publisher full text timed out. No independent PDF/figure inspection.
reports.license: arXiv v1 CC BY 4.0, confirmed in source header
normalization_and_corrections: Symplectic volume is 1/2 integral omega^2; leading capacity term is 2 sqrt(kV).
Relative integral first Chern class separated from the pre-existing rational Chern-Weil page.
No unconditional strict decrease of capacities under U; the ball has plateaus.
Do not import Lemma 2.14's density-one Euler characteristic assertion from an average bound alone.
No unchecked two-orbit period/product normalization or abbreviated PFH Weyl formula imported.
deferred: ECH compactness, transversality, gluing, index inequality and the Taubes comparison remain cited analytic theorems.
General Weyl asymptotics, ECH capacities' embedding monotonicity, and the existence of link spectral quasimorphisms are not re-proved.
Detailed PFH Weyl normalization, bounded subleading terms, packing stability, helicity topological invariance and surface-group extensions require the original research proofs.

reports.speaker: Sheel Ganatra
reports.title: Structural Approaches to Fukaya Categories and Mirror Symmetry
reports.question: 怎样由局部余核、止挡与粘合计算包裹 Fukaya 范畴，并追踪紧拉格朗日和镜像变形？
reports.reading_scope: Publisher HTML main text sections 1-4 and footnotes 1-6, publication/license information; diagrams not independently inspected, bibliography not read in full.

supplementary_sources.authors: Sheel Ganatra; John Pardon; Vivek Shende
supplementary_sources.title: Sectorial descent for wrapped Fukaya categories
supplementary_sources.read_scope: Targeted Definition 1.7, mostly Legendrian stops, publisher/author PDF extracted passage; not a full-paper reading.

normalization_and_corrections: Reuse Auroux's exact/curved/wrapped Floer pages and expand 0BLQ rather than duplicate sectorial descent.
Separate Legendrian definition, stop definition, proper category and proper left module.
Use explicit Hom formula for arclike locality, avoiding the report's conflicting adjoint label.
Arclike descent is recorded as full-faithfulness conjecture, not an equivalence or a geometric realization theorem.
deferred: Analytic proofs of generation, stop removal, Kunneth, sectorial descent and arclike locality remain cited.
General microlocal sheaf comparisons, arborealization and homotopical finite presentation are not reconstructed.
Multipotential sector constructions and general arclike descent remain source-qualified ongoing/conjectural work; no general Batyrev HMS theorem without exact hypotheses is asserted.

reports.speaker: Jeremy Hahn
reports.title: Algebraic Cohomology of Ring Spectra
reports.question: 偶测试环与动机滤过怎样把算术上同调扩展到球谱及其他交换环谱？
reports.reading_scope: Publisher HTML introduction and sections 1-4, copyright/publication information. The reduced-syntomic chart and PDF were not independently inspected or transcribed; bibliography not fully read.

supplementary_sources.authors: Jeremy Hahn; Arpon Raksit; Dylan Wilson
supplementary_sources.title: A motivic filtration on the topological cyclic homology of commutative ring spectra
supplementary_sources.read_scope: Targeted section 2.2, Definitions 2.2.4, 2.2.6, 2.2.15; Corollaries 2.2.17-18, Proposition 2.2.20 and Corollary 2.2.21, including displayed proofs; no full-paper reading.

normalization_and_corrections: Use precise eff descent from the primary paper rather than a blanket assertion for every even-cell module, which would allow vacuous zero examples.
Homological Tor amplitude [0,1]; syntomic Z_p(i) is the associated graded shifted by -2i, so cohomological degree j equals pi_(2i-j).
TC formula uses bounded-below, p-completed finite-subgroup Tate target with residual circle action; no unqualified circle norm formula.
Do not replace genuine geometric fixed points by homotopy fixed points.
No inferred presentation of the chart's generators/degrees; only the algebraic duality mechanism is proved.
General connective even-prestack full faithfulness and normed synthetic constructions retain forthcoming status.
deferred: Construction theorems for the stable homotopy category, Eilenberg-Mac Lane spectra, MU and Adams operations remain classical cited inputs, not new local proofs.
The full HRW descent and motivic-filtration proofs, reduced TC(ell) chart, transfer/duality calculations and telescope-counterexample proof are not reconstructed.
Prismatization/Nygaardification stacks, F-smooth hypotheses and genuine MU resolutions announced in section 3 are not presented as completed local constructions.
Synthetic normed E-infinity rings and their operations in section 4 retain their announced or open status.
